title: AssetAttribute - Data API
description: Stores asset attributes to track and analyze asset conditions to improve their uptime. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

AssetId.description: The ID of the asset. This field is a relationship field.

AttributeDefinitionId.description: The ID of the attribute definition for this asset attribute. This field is a relationship field.

AttributeName.description: The name given to the asset attribute in the UI by the user.

AttributePicklistValueId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AttributePicklistValueId.description: The ID of the attribute picklist value if the attribute is a picklist type. This field is a relationship field.

AttributeValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AttributeValue.description: Stores the value of an asset attribute, for example 5-TB storage .

ExternalId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalId.description: An auto-generated ID of the attribute record saved in an external system (for example an HBase database). This field is reserved and used for internal purpose.

usage: Add asset descriptors to the AssetAttribute object instead of creating multiple custom attributes on an asset. This helps scale to a high asset volume in the system.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="AssetAttribute">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="Asset" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:Asset"/>
        <element name="AssetId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="AttributeDefinition" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:AttributeDefinition"/>
        <element name="AttributeDefinitionId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="AttributeName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="AttributePicklistValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:AttributePicklistValue"/>
        <element name="AttributePicklistValueId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="AttributeValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="ExternalId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="LastModifiedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
